admission.justification: Admitting every inspected sibling as a dependency can invalidate sound reuse; omitting genuinely consumed reads can preserve unsound reuse. The explicit bucket and identity distinction prevents both mistakes across the read owners.

applicability: Coordination-file observations used by reused worklist, gate and reviewer computations, including explicit ruled-out sibling observations.
conditions: A consumer records the identity it genuinely read; kept dependency observations and explicitly examined observations have separate context buckets.
An explicitly examined ruled-out sibling stays outside the admitted kept dependency set; strict leaf selection alone marks that ruled-out observation as examined.

Each recorded_reads capture starts a fresh kept-read dictionary. Its examined bucket is explicitly supplied or inherited from the caller, so nested recorders may add to that shared examined dictionary. Finally resets restore both context bindings; they do not undo mutations of an inherited examined dictionary.
Readback and currentness may inspect the explicit observation without admitting it as a kept dependency.
exclusions: The cross-owner kept/examined distinction does not itself accept any reused result or replace exact reviewer-cache input checks.
No live cache reuse, sibling task mutation, test run or executed reader witness is claimed.
statement: Reused worklist, gate and reviewer computations may depend only on genuinely recorded coordination reads, with explicitly examined ruled-out sibling observations kept outside the admitted kept dependency set.
